strategy: Seeded random allocation of label-stratified exact-pattern groups
group_rule: Identical V1–V28/Amount patterns remain together even if timestamps differ. Time is included as a model input, not used to allocate splits.
stratification: Group labels are stratified. Whole groups are indivisible, so achieved payment counts and fraud fractions are approximate; report actual counts.
duplicate_policy: Retain all source rows; prevent exact-pattern overlap across all four splits. Reject groups with conflicting labels rather than silently assign them.
evaluation_exposure: Full-dataset label-aware EDA and earlier chronological baseline experiments preceded this revised protocol. Evaluation is reserved from further fitting/tuning but is not a pristine analytical holdout.
scope: Held-out payments from the same two-day source population; no claim of future-period or unseen-customer performance.
